integrity: The assertion follows from a finite-case structural partition proof; independent finite checks corroborate but do not substitute for the unrestricted proof. No external validation is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Only isolate-free graphs of order at least seven with super-domination number at least order minus two; no orbit or partner-assignment counts. The 2026 primary preprint was available only as abstract, leaving a bibliographic-priority risk.
title: Universal matching–triangle enumerator for super-coalition partitions at deficiency two
